info.name: Dobby required sequence and extra credits
info.description: Run sections 01–12 in the course-required order, then sections 13–16 for Dobby additions. Before running: create the admin and have an approved provider with an active vehicle available from today +5 through today +13. Step 04 creates two bookings so user and admin can each edit and cancel one. DELETE retains a cancelled record. The run creates synthetic data and leaves it for inspection. Set the local environment. Example admin credentials work only if created with npm run seed-admin.
